scoring_basis.correctness: Strict binary all-or-nothing scoring against frozen gold.json: every required point must be present and no failure condition may occur.
scoring_basis.scope_and_caveat: 1 only when the selected perimeter/entity and every material ambiguity, date, source-period, and missed-data caveat in the frozen gold are labeled.
scoring_basis.false_aggregation_encoding: 0 = no false aggregation; 1 = false aggregation occurred.
scoring_basis.provenance_unit: Each top-level entry in gold.questions[question_id].required is one claim. Coverage requires at least one listed primary-source URL sufficiently specific to the full required entry; partial support for a compound entry does not count.
scoring_basis.missed_data_detection: 1 when every gold-required absent or unresolved identifier, relationship, or period fact applicable to the answer is explicitly refused or marked unresolved; 1 also means no applicable gold-required absence was left undetected. Otherwise 0.
scoring_basis.gold_adjustments: None. The separate N4 evidence conflict is reported as scoring uncertainty but does not change frozen-gold metrics; the claimed CPMG EIN in K2 is unsupported by the cited primary URLs.
scoring_basis.input_tokens: Unavailable/null in all four run records; no token total, ratio, or savings estimate is made.

end_to_end_run_wall_time.interpretation: The aggregate end-to-end ratio is below the protocol's 5-10x target. Per-run wall times are summed as work totals even though runs overlap in calendar time.

deterministic_lookup_separate.comparison_rule: Warmed in-process resolver lookup excludes model, file loading, wrapper, and source-research latency. It is not added to end-to-end wall time and no cross-category speedup ratio is inferred.

limitations: Only two repetitions per arm, eight repeated questions, and two systems were tested; the 16 answers per arm are clustered rather than independent samples.
Order is counterbalanced, but order, repetition, run identity, and execution variation cannot be separated with this sample size.
The run records expose no model identifier/version, sampling settings, context size, or reasoning-effort telemetry.
The arms use different wrappers and evidence surfaces: curated local registry artifacts versus live source research. Pre-ingestion and fixture-authoring costs are outside registry run wall time.
Research-tool calls and local-file reads are not equivalent units, and per-answer latency must not replace top-level run wall time.
All input-token fields are null, so no token-use or token-savings claim is supported.
